    UNION
      { dbpr:Dragonfly_in_Amber

        ?author   dbpo:genre         ?authorGenre
      }
    UNION
      { dbpr:Dragonfly_in_Amber
                  dbpo:author      ?a .
        ?author   dbpo:influenced  ?a ;
                  dbpo:genre       ?authorGenre
      }
    UNION
      { dbpr:Dragonfly_in_Amber
                  dbpo:author        ?a .
        ?author   dbpo:influencedBy  ?a ;
                  dbpo:genre         ?authorGenre

  }
